name: Frostbound
description: A young white star with two blue ice giants and a single dwarf world in the far cold. The system still wears its formation dust like a veil. Everything here is new, bright, and barely settled.

stars.name: Frostbound White
stars.description: A young white star spinning fast enough to flatten, barely a billion years alight. Its debris disk still glows with formation dust. Planets here are still counting their late impacts.

planets.name: Palebound
planets.description: A methane-hazed giant fresh from formation, still contracting and glowing faintly. Storms larger than Earths spin through the deep blue. Its heat of formation outshines the starlight it receives.

planets.name: Rimehold
planets.description: A second ice giant with a captured moon and a tilt from a recent giant impact. The impact debris still forms a faint temporary ring. Its seasons last decades and arrive violently.

moons.name: Newcatch
moons.description: A dark captured rock still outgassing from its recent arrival. Its orbit decays measurably with every pass. Dynamicists bet on its eventual fate with real money.

dwarfPlanets.name: Firstfrost
dwarfPlanets.description: A small ice world wearing the system's formation dust like snow. Cryovolcanoes began resurfacing it within the last million years. It may yet grow an ocean if the heating holds.
